title: Immigration minister says poorer areas have taken ‘fair share’ of asylum seekers – UK politics live
summary_full: Anna Turley backs up Andy Burnham’s suggestion that affluent areas should house more asylum seekers in futureDisposable barbecues could be banned to help prevent fires, Andy Burnham has said.Speaking to reporters on a visit to Stevenage, Burnham said:There is obviously a significant problem of wildfires in the south. The New Forest fire is a great concern; we have seen them in northern areas, as well as Suffolk recently.This is a message for the public as well because the wildfires I mentioned, many of them have been created by disposable barbecues.
